description: After an edit to CSS, HTML, HEEx, Elixir or Go template files, runs brandkit lint on that file and tells the agent about raw design values. Warns only; fails open when brandkit isn't installed.

args: p=$(command -v brandkit); s=; case "$p" in */shims/*) s=$p; p= ;; esac; [ -n "$p" ] && m=$(command -v mise) && [ "$p" -ef "$m" ] && s=$p && p=; if [ -z "$p" ] && command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=$(mise -C / exec github:shermanhuman/brandkit -- sh -c 'command -v brandkit' </dev/null 2>/dev/null); case "$p" in */shims/*) p= ;; esac; fi; [ -z "$p" ] && p=$s; [ -n "$p" ] && "$p" lint --hook; exit 0
